question: Regarding the inheritance patterns of diseases of genetic origin, which of the following statements is true?

options.opa: A characteristic of diseases with autosomal dominant inheritance is the existence of asymptomatic carriers.
options.opb: Hereditary diseases linked to the Y chromosome are more frequent than those linked to the X chromosome.
options.opc: It is not possible to transmit a disease with mutations of mitochondrial DNA from a male affected to his offspring.
options.opd: Polygenic inheritance is one of the classic forms of Mendelian inheritance.
